title: Plate layout drawn from the topology optimiser
summary: v0.1, replaced on 2026-10-17 by the 3D frame ('The frame is drawn from a 3D topology field'). The base plate was the 2.5D optimiser's load path made printable: no hub-to-motor arms; each motor seat hung on 4 ribbed spokes (1.3 mm x 4.8 mm ribs) from its own duct ring, the hub reached the four duct-to-duct webs on ribbed bridges, and the webs were 6 mm tall. Judged by the same 2.5D plate FE on the exact printed layout (CalculiX on the printed shape has judged C4 since): first mode 286 Hz vs 187 Hz for the hand-drawn arms at the same webs, crash compliance 2.2x lower, for +0.8 g.

rejected.why: first mode 187 Hz by v0.1's 2.5D plate FE, under C4's 200 Hz
its spokes were 0.75 mm blades; the 1.6 mm minimum-member clean-up deleted them and cut the motor seats loose (first mode 7 Hz by v0.1's 2.5D plate FE)
thrust-to-weight 3.025 on v0.1's 46.3 g-a-motor thrust floor (since replaced by the kit motor's load table): no margin on C1
crash stiffness 0.85-1.18x the hand-drawn frame's (v0.1's 2.5D plate FE)
first mode 213 Hz by v0.1's 2.5D plate FE; 6 mm gives 283 Hz for 0.12 g
